description: ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD - a COBOL-2002 introduction (the 2002 standard's OPTIONS ARITHMETIC IS NATIVE|STANDARD), obsolete in 2014 and REMOVED by 2023. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 Identification Division has no OPTIONS paragraph (§1985:VI.3.2.1.1 prints `IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. program-name.` then only AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED and SECURITY; §1985:VI.3.2: "The other paragraphs are optional and may be included in this division at the user's choice, in order of presentation shown by the general format below"), and §2002:F.1 item 6 ("The following reserved words have been added") lists OPTIONS; §2002:11.8.4.2 GR2 adds "If the STANDARD phrase is specified, the techniques used in handling arithmetic expressions, arithmetic statements, the SUM clause, and certain integer and numeric functions shall be those specified for standard arithmetic", and §2002:F.2 item 4 states the change: "The STANDARD phrase specifies that certain arithmetic will be performed in a well-defined manner and may yield results that are portable." §2014:11.9.4.2 GR2 keeps the 2002 sentence and adds its NOTE 1, "Standard arithmetic is an obsolete feature of standard COBOL"; §2014:F.2 item 2 (the obsolete list) says "Implementors are encouraged to provide support for ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL in preference to ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD". §2023:E.2 item 21 removes it ("The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed", its list naming Standard Arithmetic), and the 2023 clause (§2023:11.9.5: "The ARITHMETIC clause specifies the method used in developing the intermediate results") prints only NATIVE, STANDARD-BINARY and STANDARD-DECIMAL (§2023:11.9.5.2 GR3: "If the STANDARD-DECIMAL phrase is specified, the techniques used in handling arithmetic expressions, arithmetic statements, the SUM clause, and integer and numeric functions" ...). A dual-window row: 0900 below 2002, available 2002-2014, 0807 at 2023+; Removed policy = error strict / warning permissive, aligning the removed-construct posture. STANDARD routes to the same CobolDec SDIDI engine as STANDARD-DECIMAL (the standard intermediate for its reachable operands IS the decimal form - DataBinder rationale).
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:F.2 item 4), obsolete 2014 (§2014:F.2 item 2) + 2023 removal (§2023:E.2 item 21; VCR row 28)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWAST.
OPTIONS.
    ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 A PIC 9V9(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE A = 2 / 7 * 7.
    STOP RUN.
